title: AlphaFold 2 + Cryo-Electron Tomography Resolves the 1,000-Protein Human Nuclear Pore Complex
aiSystem: AlphaFold 2 + ColabFold + Cryo-ET Integrative Modeling (MPI Biophysics / EMBL)
whyItMatters: Landmark real-world triumph of AlphaFold 2: combining AI structure prediction with cryo-electron tomography unlocked the near-atomic scaffold of the ~120 MDa, ~1,000-protein human nuclear pore complex inside intact cells.
summary: Published in a special June 2022 Science issue by Shyamal Mosalaganti, Agnieszka Obarska-Kosinska, Marc Siggel, Jan Kosinski, Martin Beck, and colleagues at the Max Planck Institute of Biophysics and EMBL (alongside companion Science papers from the Hoelz and Schwartz labs), researchers paired AlphaFold 2 and ColabFold structural predictions with in-cell cryo-electron tomography and molecular dynamics to construct a nearly complete architectural model of the human nuclear pore complex (NPC)—one of the largest protein assemblies in eukaryotic cells (~120 megadaltons, ~1,000 protein subunits guarding all traffic into and out of the cell nucleus). AlphaFold 2 filled decades-long experimental blind spots across ~20% of previously unmapped scaffold regions and revealed how the pore dilates and contracts mechanically in live cells.
technicalHighlights: Integrated AlphaFold 2 / ColabFold monomer and complex predictions directly into cryo-EM and in situ cryo-ET density maps of the ~120 MDa human NPC.
Doubled structural coverage of the human NPC scaffold (resolving ~70 MDa of the structured core across ~1,000 nucleoporin copies) including previously intractable linker and transmembrane subunits.
Revealed mechanistic plasticity showing how the nuclear pore dilates and constricts in response to cellular energy and mechanical stress.
caveats: Intrinsically disordered FG-repeat nucleoporin hydrogels filling the central transport channel remain dynamic and cannot be captured as static atomic coordinates.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrated AI structure prediction directly solving one of eukaryotic cell biology’s most iconic megadalton molecular machines.
scoreRationale.ripple: Pioneered the hybrid AI + cryo-ET integrative structural biology workflow now standard across cellular structural biology.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Science (with companion independent Science structural validations) fitted directly to experimental cryo-ET electron density.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compressed years of painstaking crystallography of recalcitrant nucleoporin subunits into rapid AI-guided integrative modeling.
